name: Canaria-Phase2B-3bit-capacity-rescue-v1
task_teacher_span: same sklearn-digits residual-MLP setup as Phase2A
quantization: 3-bit symmetric per-matrix signed uniform; FP16 scale per Linear matrix
selection: validation NMSE <=0.08 and validation accuracy >= teacher validation accuracy -0.02; test untouched until minimum passing budget selected
hypothesis: The 3-bit failure observed up to 6144 params is substantially capacity-limited: composed replacements will recover a passing endpoint by 16384 params in at least 6/8 fresh seeds.
decision: PASS if composed endpoint exists in >=6/8 seeds; FAIL if <=2/8; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
secondary: component-wise rescue rate and paired minimum coded-size ratio where both conditions pass
scope: new-phase exploratory mechanism test; frozen v0.2.0 unchanged
